prompt.alinti: Your AI can write the code, but does it know the rules your project should follow?
These 4 .md files give your AI the context it needs beyond just what to build:
🔐 SECURITY.md — Defines how your app should handle authentication, permissions, sensitive data and API keys.
💻 CODE_STYLE.md — Sets the rules for writing clean, consistent and maintainable code.
🗄️ DATABASE.md — Defines how your data should be structured, stored, related and managed.
🔗 API.md — Shows how your frontend, backend and external services should communicate.
The more project context your AI has, the less it has to guess.
Save this before your next vibe coding session.
Follow for more practical AI product-building tips and workflows.
